cases.expected: A->B->C: seed c yields affected [a,b], test [a,b,c], dependency-closure.
Edges a->b,a->c,b->d,c->d,d->b and isolated z; seed d yields affected [a,b,c], test [a,b,c,d]; traversal terminates.
Seeds [c,z] in the diamond fixture yield one union; z is a seed, not an affected module.
Seed z with no dependents yields affected [] and test [z].
Duplicate seeds and unsorted input yield deduplicated lists in UTF-8 byte order of ID.
No modules and no paths answers with empty lists, coverage and widening reported, after readiness checks.
The root module (directory ".") is a valid seed and a valid dependent.
Seeds [a,nope,zzz] fail the whole query as unknown-module with unknownModules [nope,zzz] and no selection.
A non-string seed and more than 4,096 seeds are invalid-query.
A file importing another file of its own module adds no edge and no dependent.
A path equal to an inventoried source file seeds its owner with basis inventory.
A path under a module's src/tests/ seeds that module, not a testing dependency.
<dir>/module.ramify seeds that module with basis declaration; the root's module.ramify seeds the root.
<dir>/README.md seeds that module with basis declaration.
A non-inventoried path under a module's area root, such as a fixture, seeds that module with basis area.
A path under a module area that is not on disk and not inventoried seeds that module with basis area; the answer is dependency-closure.
package.json resolves to basis none; selection is all-modules with widening [unowned-path]; changedModules and affectedModules keep the known values.
docs/notes.md resolves to basis none and widens; the caller filters documentation before asking.
An absolute path is invalid-query.
A path with a .. segment or a backslash is invalid-query.
A re-export through a barrel adds edges to the barrel owner and to the original's owner.
export * from another module adds an edge to that module.
import * as ns adds an edge to the target owner.
import type adds an edge; a type-only seed change selects the importer.
A literal dynamic import adds an edge.
A side-effect import with zero selections adds an edge to the target owner.
A denied import still adds an edge; analysisCheck is failed.
A resource whose owned declaration shim lives in another module adds an edge to the shim owner.
Exposure declarations, ancestry and resolution candidates add no edges.
A separately declared testing module importing production code is its own node and a dependent of that code.
A nonliteral dynamic import anywhere makes coverage partial and widens to all-modules with [partial-coverage].
An import of a deleted file makes coverage partial and widens.
An import of a file outside every module makes coverage partial and widens.
A project whose only notes are signature-inferred or unresolved-original keeps coverage complete and dependency-closure.
An edge count over the limit is resource-limit, never a truncated list.
After an edit adds an import from d to c and a revision publishes, seed c includes d; before it, it does not.
A sequence other than the current one is unavailable invalid-revision.
An invalid current revision is unavailable invalid-current; the previous valid answer is not returned.
A session without access interpretation answers missing-facts.
After releaseCompiler the query still answers from retained facts.
A ready query performs no source read, compiler call or report() projection, observed through the existing test seams.
The worker fixture answers affected with the same result as the in-process engine.
A cancelled worker request returns cancelled and leaves the session usable.
A published ready revision answers with that revision, freshness record and result.
A session answer naming another sequence is superseded, never relabeled.
A cold context with wait false answers cold.
A cold context with wait true opens and answers.
An invalid current input answers unavailable and never from lastValid.
An unmet deadline answers deadline-exceeded with elapsed time.
Cancellation answers cancelled and releases the lease.
The welcome lists affected; the connection method returns unsupported-operation when absent.
Malformed params (missing token, non-array modules, negative deadline) are invalid-request.
An unknown module ID is an unavailable outcome, not a service error.
The daemon answer equals the retained session's answer at the same input identity.
A real client over the socket receives the same answered document as the direct binding.
A peer without the capability yields a capability error.
A disconnect during the request releases the lease and leaves the daemon usable.
ramify affected a b parses modules [a,b].
--path x --path y parses paths [x,y] alongside module IDs.
ramify affected with no seed is an invocation error naming the requirement.
--since and --changed are unsupported arguments for affected.
--batch --format json parses both.
--format json prints one ramify.affected-cli/1 document with root, mode resident, revision and selection.
Human output lists root, mode, revision, selection, each path with module and basis, and the three module lists.
An all-modules answer exits 0 and names its widening reasons.
An unknown module ID exits 1 with the unknown set.
A cold or superseded outcome exits 2 with the ramify.cli/1 diagnostic form.
SIGINT exits 130 and releases the context.
ramify affected --batch on the reference project prints a document with mode batch and a nonempty inputId.
Resident and batch selections on the same unchanged reference project are equal except mode and sequence.
--batch on a directory without a root description exits 1.
The compiled client runs the batch form in its Node child and prints the same document.
ramify affected --path subs/analysis/src/affected-query.ts on the toolkit selects analysis, daemon, contexts, cli and root, recorded with the exact output.
ramify affected analysis on the toolkit equals the path-seeded answer.
ramify affected --path package.json widens to all modules with unowned-path.
A path seed in ramify-agent answers dependency-closure with complete coverage despite its signature notes.
ramify affected --batch on ramify-agent answers and records its elapsed time.
Five resident invocations per project and one batch invocation per project are recorded with elapsed times.
npm run check:self passes on the built execution checkout.
npm run type-check passes.
ramify-audit audit --request audit/plan7-affected-modules.request.json passes and its run reference is recorded.
